smartphone_share.guide.title: Enjoy Smartphone Content
deviceType_01941: Enjoy the screen or music from your smart phone on %deviceType% with the wide screen and immersive volume.
deviceType_01942: Cast music from smartphone to %deviceType% speaker
sn_home_0020: Network settings are required to enjoy this app. Do you want to go to 'Network Settings' for internet connection?
deviceType_01948: This service is not available in the country that your %deviceType% is set to.
sn_home_0026: Go to Settings {%androidset_icon} > Connections > Wi-Fi, then turn on Wi-Fi.
sn_home_0027: If the network is not connected on the phone, select your "{%network name}" to connect.
sn_home_0028: Select {%casting_icon} icon on the top of the screen after opening YouTube app on the smart phone.
sn_home_0029: You can use the same feature on iPhones or other apps if you see {%casting_icon} icon.
deviceType_01801: Select LG %deviceType% from the list of devices found.
deviceType_01943: If you cannot find your %deviceType% name, please agree to use terms after pressing Google Cast button.
sn_home_0033: Go to Settings {%iphoneset_icon} > Wi-Fi, then turn on Wi-Fi.
airplay.step1.secondary: If the network is not connected on the phone, select your "{%network name}" to connect.
sn_home_0034: Open Control Center by swiping down from the upper-right corner of the screen then select {%airplay_icon} icon.
deviceType_01944: If an AirPlay passcode appears on your %deviceType%, enter the passcode on your iPhone.
deviceType_01793: Play music from your Bluetooth-connected smartphone through the %deviceType% speakers.
soundshare.connect_hint: Select the Bluetooth menu from your phone's settings to connect to this %deviceType%.
sn_home_0088: Check the status of Bluetooth menu settings of your mobile device.
